security_headers.name: content-security-policy
security_headers.title: Content Security Policy is absent
security_headers.remediation: Define a Content Security Policy for this application, test it in report-only mode, then enforce it and rescan.

security_headers.name: x-content-type-options
security_headers.title: MIME sniffing protection is absent
security_headers.remediation: Return X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff on relevant responses, then rescan.

security_headers.name: referrer-policy
security_headers.title: Referrer Policy is absent
security_headers.remediation: Set a Referrer-Policy suited to the application's navigation needs, then rescan.

https_header.name: strict-transport-security
https_header.title: HTTP Strict Transport Security is absent
https_header.remediation: After confirming HTTPS works across the intended domain scope, add a suitable Strict-Transport-Security header and rescan.
